newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj sale still scheduled for 1700 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj sale still scheduled for 1700 GMT.

text.p: The sale of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj is still scheduled for 1400 local/1700 GMT, but the auction cannot go ahead until the Senate approves a deal resolving Banerj's pension-related debts, a Rio state official said.
"The state is ready to sell the bank at two o'clock," the state finance department spokeswoman said. "We'll just have to wait and see what happens."

Rio state authorities are trying to get the Senate to approve the pension deal still on Tuesday, but they also have to succeed in their efforts to overturn a court injunction which is blocking the bank's sell-off.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
